scripts.audit:advisory: bash -lc 'status=0; npm run audit:advisory:knip || status=$?; npm run audit:advisory:depcruise || status=$?; npm run audit:advisory:madge || status=$?; npm run audit:advisory:duplication || status=$?; exit $status'
scripts.audit:advisory:depcruise: (cd src/backend/server && depcruise --config ../../../.dependency-cruiser.cjs src --output-type err) && (cd src/frontend/web && depcruise --config ../../../.dependency-cruiser.cjs src --output-type err) && (cd packages/shared && depcruise --config ../../.dependency-cruiser.cjs src --output-type err)
scripts.audit:advisory:knip: (cd src/backend/server && knip --include files,dependencies,unresolved) && (cd src/frontend/web && knip --include files,dependencies,unresolved) && (cd packages/shared && knip --include files,dependencies,unresolved)
scripts.audit:advisory:madge: (cd src/backend/server && madge --extensions ts --circular src) && (cd src/frontend/web && madge --extensions ts,tsx --circular src) && (cd packages/shared && madge --extensions ts --circular src)
scripts.check:resource-index: npm run check:resource-index:manifest && npm run check:resource-index:links
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:python
